title: C63 checklist wording changed from 'the eleventh effect action' to 'an authorized effect action' — same staleness pattern as C46, now doubly stale under twelve rows
causal_chain: Base C63 read: 'R08: retention release is the eleventh effect action and requires a complete root-set epoch CAS/reachability proof.' Under the base's 11-row matrix, retention_release genuinely was row 11 (last row). Under HEAD's 12-row matrix, retention_release is now row 11 of 12 (still true ordinally) but retention_root_admission (row 12) is new and has no corresponding C-checklist entry of its own. Rather than either keeping the now-still-correct 'eleventh' or adding a new checklist item for the twelfth row, HEAD generalizes C63 to 'retention release is an authorized effect action.' This avoids a false claim but also means the new retention_root_admission action/row is not independently referenced by any checklist item (C01-C95 reviewed in full at HEAD 3679-3773; no new C-item was added for it). This is a minor completeness gap in the remediation-closure map, not a regression of any existing safeguard — the admission action itself is fully specified in section 12.3-12.4 prose and the schema-profile table (HEAD row 'retention_root_admission_result/v1' / 'retention_root_admission_proof/v1', ~HEAD 3612-3613), so the underlying control exists; only its explicit checklist cross-reference is absent.
